descriptionHtml:
Feature: Ranking activities by weather suitability

As a traveller comparing days, I want the ranking to reflect how suitable the weather is for each activity so that I can trust the recommendation without reading the raw forecast.

The scoring model belongs to the developers and will be tuned, so these scenarios never pin exact scores. They pin behaviour any sensible model must show: obvious winners for clear-cut weather (decision table), scores that move in the right direction when one factor changes (metamorphic relations), and well-formed results for any combination of weather (pairwise).

Rule: Each day is ranked on its own weather
